entry.note: Confirmed paper is 'Twisted Deformation Quantization of Algebraic Varieties' by Amnon Yekutieli (Contemporary Mathematics survey, arXiv:0801.3233v4 2011). §2 'Poisson Deformations of Algebraic Varieties' — matches QOU's citation in global-gluing.lean:28 + Torsion/GlobalGluing.lean:30 for 'O_{q(p)}(G) of functions on the quantum group deformed by the local substrate parameter'. Scope match.

relevance.rationale: BROKEN SOURCE JOIN: the named file does not exist in the tree, and no file under uploads/ corresponds to this id. The row is a legacy synthesized path from an earlier bib-verification pass, so identity could not be confirmed from front matter and no citation-support check was possible. Citation sites do exist and look substantive: folio/quantum-observable-universe/lifting-and-descent/global-gluing-proof.md:1 (the twisted-deformation datum on the coordinate bundle Coor_M is the substance of the gluing argument, so this is load-bearing prose), stack-like-structure.md:1, yekutieli-mapping-table.md:30, plus lifting-and-descent/global-gluing.lean:31/50/64/76/83 and lean/QOU/Torsion/GlobalGluing.lean:30/41/51/59/62. DEFECT FLAGGED: lean/QOU/LiftingDescent/BBStratification.lean:44 and lean/QOU/LiftingDescent/HomologicalCondensation.lean:26 both attach a journal DOI to this id, while the registered entry is a preprint record carrying no DOI at all. Either the registered entry is under-specified or those two sites point at a different work by the same author; cannot adjudicate without the source.

proposedActions.rationale: Nothing to import. The actionable items are (a) re-attach a real source file to this ledger row and (b) reconcile the DOI used at the two Lean sites against the registered entry. Both are reference-record repairs, not content-block actions.
